vibe: Premium, authoritative, cutting-edge tech agency. Cinematic, moody, expensive feel. NOT a generic AI template.

components_strategy.marketing_sections: Custom HTML/Tailwind. Use radical asymmetry, bento grids, and generative textures.
components_strategy.interactive_ui: Use Shadcn components heavily customized to match the dark jewel/glass aesthetic. Specifically for tabs, inputs, and the audit tool.

surfaces.cards: bg-[#0a0a0a] border border-white/[0.05] hover:border-white/[0.1] transition-all duration-300

pages_and_sections.name: Header
pages_and_sections.details: Sticky header (fixed w-full z-50). Crystal glassmorphism effect (backdrop-blur-md bg-[#050505]/60 border-b border-white/5). Must include Logo (Brandly Systems), 3-4 nav links, and a primary 'Book Consultation' CTA.

pages_and_sections.name: Hero
pages_and_sections.details: Massive asymmetric layout. Left: High-impact typography 'Your Business Is Losing Customers Online — Here's Why', with a subtitle and dual CTA buttons ('Audit My Website', 'Audit My Google Profile'). Right or Bottom: A visual representation of the Audit Tool interface floating in 3D or glassmorphic space. Use the hero_bg image as an absolute background layer with a dark gradient overlay.

pages_and_sections.name: Trust Logos
pages_and_sections.details: Subtle, slow-moving marquee of client logos. Opacity at 30%, grayscale. Use react-fast-marquee.

pages_and_sections.name: Audit Tool UI (The Core Lead Gen)
pages_and_sections.details:
A prominent section styled like a real SaaS product interface. Tabs for 'Website Audit' and 'GMB Audit'. User enters URL -> hits 'Scan'. Show a 2-second loading skeleton/progress bar. Then show the Report. 

CRITICAL LEAD CAPTURE MECHANIC: The report must show a large 'Score 0-100' at the top (make it look 65/100 to cause urgency), but the detailed 'Issues', 'Warnings', and 'Good' sections below it must be locked behind a heavy blur (`backdrop-blur-md`). Overlay a crisp Lead Capture Form (Name, Business Name, Email, Phone) over the blur with the copy: 'Enter details to unlock full report & optimization guide'.

pages_and_sections.name: How It Works
pages_and_sections.details: 3-step process. Use a vertical timeline or a 3-column bento grid. Step 1: Run the Audit. Step 2: Get the Strategy. Step 3: We Execute.

pages_and_sections.name: Services
pages_and_sections.details: 4 cards: Website Design, Facebook Ads, AI Automation, SMMA. Use Tetris Grid layout. The AI Automation card should span 2 columns and use the 'service_ai_automation' image.

pages_and_sections.name: Results / Case Study
pages_and_sections.details: Before vs After metrics (e.g., Conversion Rate: 1.2% -> 4.5%). Style as sharp dashboard widgets. Use the 'ui_screenshot' image as background texture.

pages_and_sections.name: Footer
pages_and_sections.details: Dark, expansive (py-32). Massive 'Let's Talk' text. Simple links for contact, services, socials.

image_urls.description: Abstract cinematic dark background with glowing purple/indigo light.
Abstract 3D glass monolith with glowing purple light, perfect for AI Automation service card.
Macbook pro on desk, use for case study or background texture.
Abstract UI texture, useful for blending into the case study section.

interactions_and_animations.hover_states: All buttons must have explicit hover states (lighter background, glow effect). Cards should use -translate-y-1 and increased border opacity.
interactions_and_animations.framer_motion: Use smooth fade-in-up (y: 20, opacity: 0) for sections as they scroll into view. The Audit Tool scan should have a sequential loading animation.
interactions_and_animations.lead_capture_reveal: When the lead form is submitted, animate the removal of the blur overlay (duration 0.5s ease) to reveal the report.

testing.required_attributes: Add data-testid to ALL interactive elements. e.g., data-testid='audit-submit-btn', data-testid='tab-website', data-testid='lead-form-name'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use 'framer-motion' for all animations.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use standard flat backgrounds. Build depth with gradients and glassmorphism. (e.g., bg-[#050505] with radial gradients in the corners).
CRITICAL: The lead capture functionality must be functional state-wise. The user shouldn't be able to bypass the blur without entering info.
Use Shadcn UI for the Tabs, Inputs, and Forms, but override their default white/light styling to match our dark theme (bg-transparent, white borders, etc).
Headings must use 'Cabinet Grotesk' or a suitable wide geometric font (like 'Clash Display'). Do not use 'Inter' for headings.
